name: mimo-tts
title: MiMo TTS
description: Expressive text-to-speech powered by Xiaomi MiMo, with voice, emotion, and pacing controls.
author: xianwei_zhang

commands.name: quick-read
commands.title: Quick Read
commands.subtitle: MiMo TTS
commands.description: Read selected or clipboard text with your default MiMo voice. Run again to stop playback.

commands.name: read-with-voice
commands.title: Read with Selected Voice
commands.subtitle: MiMo TTS
commands.description: Browse MiMo voices and read selected or clipboard text aloud.

commands.name: read-with-controls
commands.title: TTS Studio
commands.subtitle: MiMo TTS
commands.description: Generate and play MiMo speech from typed, selected, or pasted text, with voice and style controls.

commands.name: select-voice
commands.title: Set Quick Read Voice
commands.subtitle: MiMo TTS
commands.description: Choose and preview the voice used by Quick Read.

commands.name: speed-up
commands.title: Increase Reading Speed
commands.subtitle: MiMo TTS
commands.description: Increase MiMo playback speed by 0.25x. Applies to the next playback in any MiMo command.

commands.name: speed-down
commands.title: Decrease Reading Speed
commands.subtitle: MiMo TTS
commands.description: Decrease MiMo playback speed by 0.25x. Applies to the next playback in any MiMo command.

commands.name: menu-bar-status
commands.title: MiMo TTS Status
commands.subtitle: MiMo TTS
commands.description: Show playback status, speed, and controls in the menu bar.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Token Plan API Key
preferences.description: Your Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan API key. Starts with tp-.

preferences.name: tokenPlanBaseUrl
preferences.title: Token Plan Base URL
preferences.description: OpenAI-compatible Token Plan base URL from your subscription page.

preferences.name: speechRate
preferences.title: Speech Rate
preferences.description: Default speed guidance sent to MiMo. Can be overridden per playback.

preferences.name: stylePrompt
preferences.title: Speaking Style
preferences.description: Optional natural-language style guidance sent to MiMo with every request.
preferences.placeholder: Natural, clear, and restrained; suitable for long-form reading.
